song.id: number for your list, 's1'... for suggestions
song.original_artist: original artist if this is a cover
song.needs_check: true if the title/artist isn't confirmed yet
song.suggested_from: (suggestions only) the favourite artist it was suggested for
song.genre: one of the genres listed below
song.tuning: original tuning, e.g. Standard, Drop D, Half-step down
song.techniques: e.g. barre chords, power chords, fingerpicking, palm muting, bends, slides, hammer-ons, reggae skank, riff, solo
song.instrument: acoustic | electric | arrangement (not originally a guitar piece)

tab.type: chords | tab | bass | solo | fingerstyle | guitar pro
tab.paywalled: true for UG Official/Pro or other subscription-only tabs

official.url: official music video, or official audio if none

tutorials.covers: full song | riff | solo | simplified version
tutorials.simplified: true if it teaches an easier version
tutorials.linked_tab: url of the tab it follows

practice.learning_status: not started | learning | can play | mastered
practice.goal: whole song | riff | solo | sing and play
